data.name: HelpText
data.value:
OK powers the machine off. Check “Restart the system” to have it come back up instead.
If this machine can be sent to its firmware setup screen, a second option appears under the first; check it to stop at the setup screen rather than booting normally.
Cancel closes this window and leaves the machine running.
